Package com.kerosene.kfe.bootstrap.adapters.out.observability

Class KfeFinancialMetrics

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.bootstrap.adapters.out.observability.KfeFinancialMetrics
@Component public class KfeFinancialMetrics extends Object
Micrometer counters and gauges for KFE transaction lifecycle observability.

Safe when MeterRegistry is absent (tests / minimal profiles).

  • Method Details

    • recordTransaction

      public void recordTransaction(String rail, String direction, String status)
      Increments the transaction lifecycle counter with rail, direction, and status dimensions. Missing dimensions are represented by UNKNOWN; no-op when metrics are unavailable.
      Parameters:
      rail - payment rail label
      direction - transaction direction label
      status - lifecycle status label
